verdict.rationale: Docs show per-user API keys and a request audit log in the self-hosted bundle, plus entity-scoped memory (user/agent/app/session) for separating data — a baseline for governance and auditing. However, there is no evidence of role-based access control, fine-grained policies, or ACLs governing who/what can read or write memory. Missing for 10: documented roles/permission levels, policy-based access rules, ACLs restricting read/write per user or agent, and independent corroboration of the audit log's usefulness.
